item.title: Ask for a graph and get a picture
item.summary: Ask Murph for a graph, chart, or trend line, such as how everyone's sleep has moved over the past week, and it draws one as an image and sends it to the chat.
item.details: Charts default to Murph’s cream, slate, and sage palette with clear labels. Murph repeats the key numbers in text because a drawn chart is a picture rather than an exact readout. Image generation follows the usual plan limits.

tryIt.label: Ask for a sleep graph
tryIt.prompt: Can you make me a sleep trend graph for the last two weeks?
